scientific_integrity: The all-alphabet proof is combinatorial. Five canonical multiplicity components are exhausted. Small-alphabet tests are corroboration, not an infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for four coordinates, disjoint simultaneous adjacent transpositions, zero-error unique decoding; no statement about longer-block capacities or successive swaps. Prior binary value is explicitly credited. Earlier unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Exact four-coordinate \(q\)-ary limited-permutation code capacity
